---
applyTo: "src/**/*.tsx,src/app/**"
---

# UI Instructions

- Use accessible labels.
- Do not rely on color alone.
- Preserve focus-visible styles.
- Use `aria-live` for async success/failure when relevant.
- Use confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.
- Avoid copy that sounds like investment advice.
- Use "整理", "確認", "提案" rather than "判断", "推奨".
